ITEM.PTXT: The arc tube of the HID bulb is filled with a rare gas (xenon gas) and metal iodides (zinc, sodium and scandium), and arc discharge occurs in the arc tube due to the voltage applied to the base side and lead wire side.
UV-cut glass that absorbs ultraviolet rays is used for the outer tube of the arc tube, keeping ultraviolet radiation to a level equivalent to that of halogen bulbs.
